howTo.title: How to Swap Face in a Video with AI
howTo.description: Create realistic, high-quality face swap videos with our free video face swap AI in a few simple steps:

step1.title: 1. Upload the video you want to swap face
step1.description: Upload the original video where you want to replace a face (or multiple faces).
step1.supportFormats: We support all common video formats
step1.clearFaces: Make sure the faces in the video are clear and visible
step1.quality: Higher video quality usually gives better results

step2.title: 2. Upload the video you want to swap face with (optional)
step2.description: If you want to swap faces between two videos (for example, your own video and a movie clip):
step2.secondVideo: Upload the second video that contains the face you want to use
step2.detectBoth: Our AI will detect faces in both videos
step2.chooseFace: You can choose which face to map and replace
step2.singleImage: If you only want to use a single face image, you can skip this and go to the next step.

step3.title: 3. Upload a face image for swapping
step3.description: Upload a photo of the face you want to put into the video.
step3.wellLit: Make sure the face is well lit
step3.avoidFilters: Avoid heavy filters or face coverings (like sunglasses or masks)
step3.autoAlign: The AI will automatically align the face to match the angle, lighting, and expression in the video.

step4.title: 4. Crop the video clip (optional)
step4.description: You can crop the uploaded video to focus only on the part where you want to swap the face.
step4.trim: Trim the start and end time
step4.focus: Focus on the main scene where the face is visible
step4.improve: This can improve speed and output quality
step4.generate: Once you're happy with the clip, hit Generate and let the AI create your new video.
